en.text:
Improves <strand/>Drengr's Lash and grants <strand/>Woven Mail for 10 seconds upon <strand/>Suspending enemies.

When used with a Barricade:
<strand/>Drengr's Lash creates 2 additional Lashes. Lashes gain stronger seeking capabilities, travel 16.7% (5 meters) farther, and <strand/>Suspend for 3 seconds longer (2 seconds for Minibosses). 

When used with <arc/>Thruster:
Created <strand/>Strand Knot is launched towards nearby enemies with some tracking. Detonates and <strand/>Suspends nearby targets on contact.
